name: constant-access-test-53bc132680/constant-access-v
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Import declarations; Constant declarations; Module variable declarations; Type definition; Function definition
Expressions: Literal — Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only; Variable reference; `Call`; List constructor; Member access expression
reason: All exercised behavior is supported: imported public constants and singleton/union type definitions, imported function calls including module initialization, final module variables, negative numeric literals with whitespace, array/tuple construction and indexing, and assignment of an imported singleton constant to a local singleton type. The asserted outputs are the resulting numeric and string values, including integral float formatting. No applicable restriction excludes these operations.
test_design_notes: io:println is output instrumentation. The @output assertions check imported values, initialization, negative values, array indexing and singleton assignment; there are no @args or @panic assertions.
Despite its name, floatIntConversion uses float literals and a float array; it does not exercise an explicit int-to-float conversion.
